Yes, that's clear and reassuring. Searching "volcano" gave me a tidy "Nothing found" message with a little prompt to try another word or clear the search to see everything again — so it's obviously "there's just nothing matching that," not "the app broke." The gentle nudge on what to do next means I'm never left staring at a blank screen wondering if something went wrong or how to get back to my links.

That's exactly how I'd want an empty search to feel — calm and helpful rather than alarming. Happy with this.
